title: Una skill convierte a Codex en especialista

toolchain.reason: Freeze verified claims, URLs, audience, runtime, and stable shot IDs before visual interpretation.
Assign a deliberate armature, focal hierarchy, safe zone, and camera target to every scene.
Carry the recognizable red SKILL packet and its causal state across all seven adjacent seams.
Produce eight deterministic custom SVG mechanism assets with stable geometry and source-bound semantics.

toolchain.reason: Render eight fixed-frame semantic workbenches with dominant manifest-bound assets, deterministic timestamp state, browser capture, and ffmpeg encoding.
